messages:
Anita: Quick sync — deciding scoring weights for the new-model onboarding rubric. Want to lock these before sprint planning. Thinking: accuracy=35, latency=25, cost=15, safety=15, infra-risk=10. Thoughts?
Ravi: +1 to locking. How are we measuring accuracy? eval-suite pass rate or held-out nll? I prefer pass rate on 8 core eval sets.
Eve: +1 from quality. Also suggest we cap cost weight to 10 for gen-heavy workloads; else cost dominates and we drop useful models.
Kai: For latency, we should consider p95 and cold-start. Maybe split latency => p50=10, p95=15 and combine to 25. Also any constraints from roadmap (LLM latency SLO=150ms) ?
Anita: Good call. Proposal v2: accuracy=35, latency_p50=10, latency_p95=15, cost=10, safety=15, infra-risk=15. That sums to 100. Anyone object?
Ravi: No objection. One more: quantization risk. Add a small penalty if 8-bit quant causes >3% accuracy drop on core prompts. Could be part of infra-risk.
Eve: Agreed. Should we add a gating checklist for bring-up? Quick draft:
```
- smoke load test (10k tokens/min)
- eval-suite pass >= 92% on core sets
- p95 latency <= 150ms at target qps
- quantization check: delta_accuracy <= 3%
- ops runbook + rollback plan
```
Kai: Can we put numbers for "smoke load test"? e.g., 100 concurrent streams -> 10k tokens/min.
Anita: I'll add that. Also routing policy: default -> hosted low-cost variant, fallback to dedicated. We need canary rollout steps: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with 24h at each stage.
Ravi: For prioritization board, tag models with 'roadmap-impact' if they support embeddings or retrieval augmentation; weight boost +10 to final score.
Eve: +1. Also add manual QA for hallucination-sensitive tasks.
ops-bot: deploy Canary started for model: astrid-12b-v1 -> canary id 3421
Anita: Nice. Owners: Ravi (metrics/evals), Eve (quality/regressions), Kai (infra/latency), Anita (product alignment). Can we finalize by EOD so PMs can include for planning?
Ravi: I'll run a quick eval tonight and post results.
Eve: I'll draft the gating checklist in the PR.
Kai: I'll set up the smoke test harness and share results link.
Anita: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD I'll push these weights as the default onboarding rubric. :thumbsup:
Ravi: LGTM
Eve: LGTM
Kai: LGTM
